beatLines.text: ◈ THE TRIAL — the audience is restless. The System offers Imani a trial, broadcast live. Survive it and take the slot. Refuse it and... well. The audience remembers refusals. (Ability slots: 5)

◈ RESONANCE HARMONICS — SYSTEM: "HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. Objects with high observer-attention waveforms function as auxiliary capacitors. We call this RESONANCE HARMONICS. We do not know why the waveforms taste like grief. We have stopped asking." — Hold a keepsake. Think about them. The System will do the math. (It is not math. It is love. The System will never know.) Channel keepsakes from your pack.
SYSTEM: "DEMONSTRATION. Give me that — Grandma's Tin Cup. WATCH."
💛 You hold Grandma's Tin Cup and practice — one gift, deeply. They would want you to get better at this. (+6 experience to Gossip Network)

💛 You hold Grandma's Tin Cup. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, worn smooth by use, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)

🍖 FEAST 📺 — Imani opens the pantry wide: 6× Canned soup, 1× Garden harvest (dried), 1× Foraged food (dried). Lauren, Sofia, James, David eat until the fire burns low. Somebody laughs so hard they cry. For one evening, nobody is surviving — they're just together. (−2,106 kcal from the pantry) The channeled keepsake feeds the feast — the feast was the weapon, and the surge rides the fire until tomorrow's dawn, spent only when the blades are warmed. (FEAST SURGE ×1.5 armed)
🍖 FEASTED ×2.25 until tomorrow's dawn (6 parts left): a legendary spread. A channeled keepsake feeds the flames (devotion ×1.5). Strikes and abilities hit with the feast behind them.
